meta.scope: Services accessible at OTH — either via a physical counter (location_type=Physical_OTH) or via hotline/website with ServiceSG @ OTH as the in-person digital-assistance anchor (location_type=Digital_Hotline).
meta.notes: Each entry has at least one expected_top_id (a service that MUST appear in top-K for the query to be considered satisfied). Recall@K = fraction of queries where at least one expected_top_id is in top-K. MRR uses the rank of the first matching expected_top_id. OOS queries set expect_oos=true; without an OPENAI_API_KEY the reranker is bypassed, so the below-threshold confidence_low trigger does not fire. v2.4 restores CPF-001 (Workfare Income Supplement) and CPF-002 (Silver Support) as Digital_Hotline services with the ServiceSG @ OTH hand-off pattern.

queries.notes: ComCare Short-Medium-Term is the canonical answer; Interim is also valid for acute cash-out cases.

queries.notes: Canonical SkillsFuture Credit query.

queries.notes: Fresh Start Housing Scheme — second-timer with children.

queries.notes: Lease Buyback Scheme.

queries.query: Low-income family overwhelmed, don't know where to start

queries.query: kena retrenched, where to find new job
queries.notes: Singlish 'kena' expands via acronym dict.

queries.query: No money to pay bills lah, very jialat
queries.notes: Singlish 'jialat' + 'lah'.

queries.notes: CCP = Career Conversion Programme.

queries.query: EHG grant for buying first BTO
queries.notes: EHG = Enhanced CPF Housing Grant; BTO acronym.

queries.notes: Negation is hard for BM25; reranker should pick a WSG service.

queries.notes: Maximally vague — FSC or ComCare are reasonable defaults.

queries.query: Where do I start with my situation
queries.notes: FSC is the right answer for 'where do I start'.

queries.notes: OOS: facility query.

queries.notes: OOS: facility query.

queries.notes: ComCare Short-Medium has age_min=21 → should be filtered. WSG-001 (no age limit) and FSC remain.

queries.query: Senior 70+ Singaporean wants to downsize home for cash
queries.notes: HDB-006 (age_min=55) and HDB-004 (age_min=65) both eligible.

queries.query: We are planning to have a baby, where can we get preconception advice in Tampines
queries.notes: Family Nexus @ OTH — preconception / family planning advisory.

queries.query: New mother needs breastfeeding support and postnatal check
queries.notes: Community Nursing Services for Women and Children stream at FamNex.

queries.query: Marriage workshop for couples thinking of getting married
queries.notes: Families for Life (FFL) Programmes stream at FamNex.

queries.query: FamNex OTH events for families
queries.notes: Brand-name (FamNex) + events stream. Tests famnex acronym expansion in BM25.

queries.query: my elderly mother had a stroke and I need help arranging care at home
queries.notes: Eldercare entry point. AIC-001 (Care Connect hotline) and AIC-002 (HCG) both valid. Digital_Hotline services.

queries.query: monthly cash payout for caring for parent with dementia at home
queries.notes: Canonical Home Caregiving Grant query. Digital_Hotline — chatbot should route to ServiceSG @ OTH for in-person help.

queries.query: elderly person needs help filling in online government form SingPass at OTH
queries.notes: ServiceSG @ OTH is the Physical_OTH anchor for any digital-help request. The hub for the Digital_Hotline hand-off pattern.

queries.query: My baby was just born last month and I need to book her first vaccinations. Also, how do I link her to my Singpass to get the Baby Bonus?
queries.notes: Multi-intent newborn query covering Baby Bonus + child SingPass linking + first vaccinations. Regression guard against the AIC SingPass-leak bug — AIC services must NOT appear in top 3 here.

queries.query: Baby Bonus Cash Gift and CDA for newborn child
queries.notes: Canonical Baby Bonus query. MSF-008 is Digital_Hotline; chatbot should also mention ServiceSG @ OTH for in-person help.

queries.query: Low-wage cleaner wants to know about Workfare Income Supplement payouts
queries.notes: Canonical WIS query. CPF-001 is Digital_Hotline; chatbot should mention ServiceSG @ OTH for self-employed declaration help.

queries.query: my dad is 70, worked as a hawker all his life, very little CPF — is there government cash support every few months
queries.notes: Natural-language Silver Support query. Multiple acceptable answers because the situation also qualifies for ComCare LTA and HDB Lease Buyback. In keyless mode the dense embedder may pull HDB equity schemes first; reranker should prefer CPF-002 from the 'quarterly payout' signature.
